# Cliently

> > Cliently is a cold email and sales enablement platform offering 100% email deliverability with AI-powered outbound sales automation.

Cliently provides tools for B2B lead generation, cold email campaigns, and sales automation with a focus on inbox placement and demo booking. The platform integrates with Google Workspace, includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, and offers templates and strategies for outbound sales teams.

## Key Topics

- Cold Email Templates
- Email Deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
- Lead Generation
- Sales Enablement
- Demo Booking
- Outbound Sales
- B2B Sales
- Marketing Automation
- Google Workspace Integration
- CRM Tools
- Sales Tools Comparison (Apollo.io, NeverBounce)
- Email Subject Lines
- Marketing Enablement
- Press Release Campaigns
- B2B Marketing Strategy

## Platform Features

- [100% Email Deliverability](https://cliently.com/100-email-deliverability): Cliently's inbox placement guarantee with pay-per-read beta signup
